property_summary: After any single successful call to SetMinSum by any caller, the correct contract always allows subsequent calls to SetMinSum (i.e., it does not permanently lock out the function), whereas the mutant that removes resetting locked_ will permanently block further SetMinSum calls after the first, causing a subsequent call to revert.
change_summary: Remove the state reset at the end of the modifier so locked_ remains true after function execution, preventing subsequent SetMinSum calls (observable change to SetMinSum after first call).
